notes.title: Update 0.0.3
notes.content:
- Changed Damage Multiplier order, now the damage is calculated as (BaseDamage * SkillDamageMultiplier * TalentTreeDamageMultiplier).
- Now the magnet drops every 350 zombies killed
- Visual Improvements

notes.title: Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
- Skills and Modifiers rebalance
- Fixed dead zombies rotating in the ground
- Fixed Modifier Level with wrong value in the Level Up screen
- Increased Level Up option opacity for better readability
- Fixed Armor damage calculation, now the percentage is a damage increase. eg. -10% Armor = +10% Damage
- Fixed dead zombies blocking projectiles
- Fixed cooldown reduction calculation
